question:
Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.

The new software update includes several enhancments to improve performance.
solution:
The correct answer is** option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**The misspelled word is 'enhancments'.**

__
 
• **The correct spelling would be 'enhancements'.**
 
• The word '**enhancements**' is a **noun** which means 'improvements or upgrades made to something'. **(सुधार)**
 
 
• **For Example -** 
 
• The new software update includes several enhancements to improve performance.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer would be** 'enhancments'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Let's understand the meanings of the other marked words - **

 
• **Software -** the programs and other operating information used by a computer **(सॉफ्टवेयर)**
 
• **Update -** make something more modern or up to date **(अद्यतन करना)**
 
• **Performance -** the action or process of performing a task or function **(प्रदर्शन)**
